default.title: Read the project README
default.description: Understand the high-level purpose, architecture, and setup steps of the project.

default.title: Set up your local development environment
default.description: Install dependencies, configure environment variables, and run the app locally.

default.title: Review the contributing guidelines
default.description: Understand the branching strategy, PR process, and code review expectations.

default.title: Meet your onboarding buddy
default.description: Schedule a 30-minute intro call with your assigned buddy.

default.title: Join the relevant Slack / Teams channels
default.description: Ask your buddy for the list of channels you should be in.

default.title: Explore the codebase top-level structure
default.description: Browse the directories and understand what each module does at a high level.

default.title: Complete your first small ticket
default.description: Pick up a good-first-issue ticket and submit a PR.

Backend Engineer.title: Understand the API design patterns
Backend Engineer.description: Read existing API controllers/routes to understand REST conventions used.

Backend Engineer.title: Review the database schema
Backend Engineer.description: Understand the main tables/collections, relationships, and migration strategy.

Backend Engineer.title: Run the test suite
Backend Engineer.description: Run all unit and integration tests locally and confirm they pass.

Backend Engineer.title: Understand error handling and logging conventions
Backend Engineer.description: Read how errors are caught, logged, and surfaced in the backend.

Backend Engineer.title: Implement a simple CRUD endpoint
Backend Engineer.description: Add a new endpoint following existing patterns as your first coding task.

Frontend Engineer.title: Set up the frontend dev server
Frontend Engineer.description: Run the frontend locally with hot-reload enabled.

Frontend Engineer.title: Understand the component library / design system
Frontend Engineer.description: Browse existing UI components and understand naming and styling conventions.

Frontend Engineer.title: Review the state management approach
Frontend Engineer.description: Understand how global vs local state is managed (Redux, Context, Zustand, etc.).

Frontend Engineer.title: Fix a small UI bug
Frontend Engineer.description: Pick a small visual bug or tweak as your first task.

Full-Stack Engineer.title: Understand the API design patterns
Full-Stack Engineer.description: Read existing API controllers/routes to understand REST conventions used.

Full-Stack Engineer.title: Review the database schema
Full-Stack Engineer.description: Understand the main tables/collections, relationships, and migration strategy.

Full-Stack Engineer.title: Set up the frontend dev server
Full-Stack Engineer.description: Run the frontend locally with hot-reload enabled.

Full-Stack Engineer.title: Trace a full request from UI to DB and back
Full-Stack Engineer.description: Pick a simple feature and follow the code path end-to-end.

Full-Stack Engineer.title: Implement a small end-to-end feature
Full-Stack Engineer.description: Add a feature that touches both frontend and backend as your first task.

DevOps / Platform Engineer.title: Understand the CI/CD pipeline
DevOps / Platform Engineer.description: Review the pipeline config files (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) and understand each stage.

DevOps / Platform Engineer.title: Review infrastructure-as-code files
DevOps / Platform Engineer.description: Read Terraform, Helm charts, or CloudFormation templates to understand the deployed topology.

DevOps / Platform Engineer.title: Access the monitoring dashboards
DevOps / Platform Engineer.description: Log in to the observability platform (Grafana, Datadog, etc.) and browse key dashboards.

DevOps / Platform Engineer.title: Deploy a change to staging
DevOps / Platform Engineer.description: Make a small config change and push it through the pipeline to the staging environment.

Data Engineer.title: Understand the data pipeline architecture
Data Engineer.description: Review how data flows from source systems to the data warehouse or lake.

Data Engineer.title: Review existing DAGs / jobs
Data Engineer.description: Browse current Airflow DAGs or equivalent pipeline definitions.

Data Engineer.title: Connect to the data warehouse locally
Data Engineer.description: Set up credentials and run a test query against the warehouse.

Data Engineer.title: Add a small transformation to an existing pipeline
Data Engineer.description: Implement a minor data transformation as your first coding task.

QA / Test Engineer.title: Understand the QA strategy and test levels
QA / Test Engineer.description: Review the testing documentation — unit, integration, E2E, and manual testing scope.

QA / Test Engineer.title: Run the full E2E test suite
QA / Test Engineer.description: Execute the end-to-end tests locally and review the results.

QA / Test Engineer.title: Review the bug tracking workflow
QA / Test Engineer.description: Understand how bugs are filed, triaged, and linked to releases.

QA / Test Engineer.title: Write a test for an untested feature
QA / Test Engineer.description: Identify a gap in test coverage and write a new test as your first task.

Technical Lead.title: Review open architectural decisions (ADRs)
Technical Lead.description: Read existing Architecture Decision Records and understand pending decisions.

Technical Lead.title: Meet all team members individually
Technical Lead.description: Schedule brief 1-on-1 introductions with each team member in your first week.

Technical Lead.title: Review the current sprint / backlog
Technical Lead.description: Understand priorities, blockers, and in-flight work.

Technical Lead.title: Identify your first technical improvement area
Technical Lead.description: Document one area of technical debt or improvement you want to tackle.
